item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.77

  • Improves Companion Realtime Voice text-message handoffs so complete requests like “Text Sam that I am late” produce a Messages draft with the intended recipient and body.
  • Asks for the missing recipient when the user requests a text draft without saying who it is for, instead of sending a malformed iPhone action.
  • Keeps the placeholder/no-speech filtering and Cerebras/local middle-brain support from the prior release.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.76

  • Filters local speech-recognition placeholder text such as blank audio, no speech detected, inaudible, and unintelligible before Companion Realtime Voice sends a turn to the middle brain.
  • Keeps Companion Realtime Voice aligned with the iOS placeholder/no-speech guard added for the latest phone build.
  • Preserves the Cerebras middle-brain and local iPhone action fixes from the prior releases.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.75

  • Ensures Cerebras API keys saved in VoiceClaw Companion are persisted into the runtime config even after reset or before the bridge config exists.
  • Keeps Companion Realtime Voice Cerebras middle-brain setup aligned with the iOS app key-entry and QR sync path.
  • Preserves the current-location plus Apple Maps directions repair added in the prior release.
